purpose: functional verification of restoring sandboxes of another size from templates built at that size, on KVM; the times are the check's own stopwatch and not a benchmark

cases.name: a size built at start: its sandboxes are restored from it, each with its own randomness
a size built when first asked for: the first boots, the next are restored
a resize and a fork to a built size are restored from it
restored at another size, it is still its own size: pauses whole, no checkpoint

detail.checkpoint_refused: sandbox sbx-64f3c336b9694225b8df is a size of its own, not its template's, and such a sandbox cannot be checkpointed; it can be paused

cases.name: with as many sizes held as allowed, another size boots every time
